_about: RECORDED 2026-10-09 from Studio › Logo AS IT STOOD BEFORE any control moved onto the templates: MakerLogoDoor (an image layer, the new Maker on) was bundled with esbuild (its server action replaced by a recorder), loaded in Chromium at 375 px and driven (a frame added · its kind picked · the colour picked in the one picker and in the shipped inks · each slider moved · Centre it · a layer moved down · a layer removed · Remove white background · Motion In and Out · Starts after · a rename · and a refused / dropped save). calls = every server action the page called, with the FormData it built (as [name, value] pairs). A layer id is random per session and is masked as ID here. says_before / says_after = what the page announced to the Maker toolbar (the old page announced the database words on a refusal). Re-record only with a reason written in the commit.
